She tucked the note into her coat and climbed back to the light.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有完全睡着，也还没有开始醒来。街灯在湿漉漉的路面上拉出橙黄的倒影，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，声音格外清晰。便利店的玻璃门后，收银员靠在柜台上，眼神空洞。楼道里传来早班工人拉行李箱的声音，轮子碾过地砖，一格一格。远处的立交桥上，几辆货车排成细线，尾灯在雾气里晕开。城市在这个时刻像一台巨大的机器，悄悄换挡，悄悄转向，不声张，不解释，只是继续运转。有人结束了昨天，有人还没开始今天。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by calling itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem, like a set of Russian nesting dolls where each doll contains a slightly smaller copy.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\" — a simple situation where it stops calling itself and just gives back an answer, otherwise it would go on forever.\n• For example, to count down from 5 to 1, you could say: \"print 5, then do the same thing starting from 4\" — the function repeats its own instructions on a smaller number until it reaches 1 and stops."}
